required_input_schema.chemical_potentials: Source and drain chemical potentials with sign, energy origin, and units.
required_input_schema.temperature: Electronic/nuclear temperature and the exact thermal convention used in the QCLE benchmark.
required_input_schema.lead_coupling_matrix: Energy-dependent lead-coupling or hybridization matrix for every benchmark curve.
required_input_schema.initial_state: Full electronic-nuclear initial density and sampling distribution.
required_input_schema.dimensional_conventions: Coordinate, momentum, mass, friction, time, and hbar conventions used to nondimensionalize Eq. (S18).
required_input_schema.qcle_integrator: Integrator, time step, trajectory count, convergence rule, and stochastic seed policy.
required_input_schema.phenomenological_mapping: The Lindblad rates and mapping used for the comparison curves.

T011.acceptance_boundary: Generate all four series from the frozen parameter card, require normalization and grid/trajectory convergence, and only then compare with the paper.
